Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer introduced the incorrect birthplace from Britannica (“Nizhny Novgorod, Russia, U.S.S.R.”) without cross-verifying against other authoritative sources. Multiple reputable sources (e.g., Wikipedia, Radio Free Europe) consistently state Boris Nemtsov was born in Sochi. Relying on a single, likely erroneous Britannica “Quick Facts” entry and not reconciling the discrepancy led to the wrong trajectory for the solution.
